SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn, t.* FROM ( SELECT sl.sale_number as "number", sl.sale_date as "date", c.name as name, plg.code, plg.name as goodsName, plg.model, plg.unit as unitName, plg.price, plg.num, plg.total, gt.name as typeName FROM t_sale_list sl LEFT JOIN t_customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_sale_list_goods plg ON sl.id = plg.sale_list_id LEFT JOIN t_goods_type gt ON plg.type_id = gt.id
AND sl.sale_date >= TO_DATE(#{saleListQuery.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND sl.sale_date <= TO_DATE(#{saleListQuery.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND (plg.name LIKE '%' || #{saleListQuery.goodsName} || '%' OR plg.code = #{saleListQuery.goodsName})
AND plg.type_id IN
#{typeId}
ORDER BY sl.sale_date DESC ) t WHERE rownum <= #{end} ) tmp WHERE rn >= #{start}

select to_char(t2.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "saleDate", sum(nvl(t3.purchasing_price, 0) * t1.num) as "amountCost", sum(nvl(t1.price, 0) * t1.num) as "amountSale" from t_sale_list_goods t1 LEFT JOIN t_sale_list t2 on t1.sale_list_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN t_goods t3 on t1.goods_id = t3.id
and trunc(t2.sale_date) >= to_date(#{begin}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
and trunc(t2.sale_date) <= to_date(#{end}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY to_char(t2.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY to_char(t2.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ASC

select to_char(t2.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM') as "saleMonth", sum(nvl(t3.purchasing_price, 0) * t1.num) as "amountCost", sum(nvl(t1.price, 0) * t1.num) as "amountSale" from t_sale_list_goods t1 LEFT JOIN t_sale_list t2 on t1.sale_list_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN t_goods t3 on t1.goods_id = t3.id
and trunc(t2.sale_date) >= to_date(#{begin} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
and trunc(t2.sale_date) <= last_day(to_date(#{end} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
GROUP BY to_char(t2.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY to_char(t2.sale_date, 'YYYY-MM') ASC
